## Context

This report reproduces the modelling workflow developed during my Master 2 internship at Altopictus (MISArbO project, 2025 surveillance season). It aims to identify environmental factors associated with the **probability of detecting West Nile virus (WNV) RNA** in two matrices: wetland water (ZH) and mosquito excreta collected by xenomonitoring (MX).

::: {.callout-important}
## Simulated data
The original data belong to the project partners. This report runs on a **synthetic dataset** generated by `R/00_simulate_data.R`, with the same structure and orders of magnitude as the real study. Results below are random and must **not** be interpreted biologically.
:::

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(splines)
library(DHARMa)
library(broom.mixed)

set.seed(2025)
```

## Data

```{r data}
db <- read.csv("../data/simulated/DB_FULL_simulated.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

db <- db %>%
  mutate(
    date_releve_dt = as.POSIXct(date_releve_dt, tz = "UTC"),
    Pos_Neg_WNV    = factor(Pos_Neg_WNV, levels = c("NEG", "POS")),
    site_acronyme  = as.factor(site_acronyme),
    mois = factor(mois, levels = c("Avril", "Mai", "Juin", "Juillet",
                                   "Août", "Septembre", "Octobre")),
    doy  = as.integer(format(date_releve_dt, "%j")),
    sx   = as.numeric(scale(x)),
    sy   = as.numeric(scale(y))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WNV_bin))

db %>%
  group_by(MatrixType) %>%
  summarise(sites = n_distinct(site_acronyme),
            samples = n(),
            wnv_positive = sum(WNV_bin),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Samples and WNV detections by matrix")
```

## Seasonal pattern of detections

```{r positivity}
db %>%
  group_by(MatrixType, mois) %>%
  summarise(positivity = 100 * mean(WNV_bin), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(mois, positivity, fill = MatrixType)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "WNV positivity (%)", fill = "Matrix") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Models

Binomial generalised linear mixed models (`lme4::glmer`) with site as a random effect. Weather covariates (15-day mean temperature, 15-day cumulated precipitation, 24-hour cumulated radiation) and coordinates are standardised. Seasonality is modelled with a natural cubic spline of the day of year (4 degrees of freedom), as non-linear seasonal dynamics differ between matrices.

```{r models}
fit_matrix <- function(data) {
  d <- data %>%
    mutate(
      temp_s   = as.numeric(scale(cop_temp_mean_15d)),
      precip_s = as.numeric(scale(cop_precip_sum_15d)),
      rad_s    = as.numeric(scale(cop_rad_sum_24h))
    )
  glmer(
    Pos_Neg_WNV ~ temp_s + precip_s + rad_s + sy + sx +
      ns(doy, df = 4) + (1 | site_acronyme),
    data = d, family = binomial
  )
}

m_zh <- fit_matrix(filter(db, MatrixType == "Zones humides"))
m_mx <- fit_matrix(filter(db, MatrixType == "Xénomonitoring"))
```

### Odds ratios

```{r odds}
or_table <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_zh, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(matrix = "Wetland water (ZH)"),
  tidy(m_mx, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(matrix = "Xenomonitoring (MX)")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)", !grepl("^ns\\(", term))

or_table %>%
  transmute(matrix, term,
            OR = round(estimate, 2),
            `95% CI` = paste0(round(conf.low, 2), "–", round(conf.high, 2)),
            p = signif(p.value, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r forest, fig.height=4}
ggplot(or_table, aes(estimate, term, colour = matrix)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Model diagnostics (DHARMa)

Simulated residuals are used to check uniformity, dispersion and outliers.

```{r dharma, fig.height=4}
res_zh <- simulateResiduals(m_zh)
res_mx <- simulateResiduals(m_mx)

plot(res_zh, title = "Wetland water (ZH)")
plot(res_mx, title = "Xenomonitoring (MX)")
```

```{r dharma-tests}
data.frame(
  matrix = c("ZH", "MX"),
  uniformity_p = c(testUniformity(res_zh, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
                   testUniformity(res_mx, plot = FALSE)$p.value),
  dispersion_p = c(testDispersion(res_zh, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
                   testDispersion(res_mx, plot = FALSE)$p.value),
  outliers_p   = c(testOutliers(res_zh, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
                   testOutliers(res_mx, plot = FALSE)$p.value)
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Limits

- Usutu virus (USUV) detections were too few (n = 13) to fit robust models in the original study; they are not modelled here.
- With a limited number of positives (n = 90 for WNV), models were fitted separately for each matrix and with few positives, so the models are exploratory and prone to overfitting.
- Associations are exploratory and do not imply causality.
